adjudication.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#remove_member the diff replaces the prior membership-removal path (previously `group.remove(user)` in update_patch) with `group.users.delete(user_id)` and then `group.save`. For a has_many/through association, `delete` removes the join row directly (no join-model callbacks), unlike the existing add path which calls `group.add(user)`. Since `group.save` doesn’t change any Group attributes here, it won’t inherently fix any counter/cache maintenance that would normally run via the association remove/callback path, so cached/denormalized counts like `user_count` can become stale after removals.
